metric: contest win rate = share of graded games where the control's number is closer to the actual margin than the no-knowledge baseline (mean home margin fitted on the same training weeks) - identical rule, identical set as signals strategy S1

controls.name: Coin flip (random picks)
controls.rule: Seeded 50/50 side draw (random.Random, seed 20261115). Margin number = 0 every game: a coin flip expresses no margin information. Never ranked; published beside the leaderboard as the luck control.

controls.name: Favourites only
controls.rule: Pick the club with the higher verified win pct entering the week (results feed only; equal pct -> home). Margin number = +/-1: direction without magnitude. Brier probability = pct_home / (pct_home + pct_away). Never ranked; published beside the leaderboard as the control.

model_side_published.name: Model side (published signals engine)
model_side_published.rule: scripts/x3_signals.py S1 - contest vs the same no-knowledge baseline.
